title: pvAnnotateTime
body:
## pvAnnotateTime

Source (no input) that produces a one-cell table whose Text column holds the requested animation time formatted with Format, e.g. "Time: 0.250000". It reports the time the pipeline asks it to update, not a dataset's time; when no time is requested the text is "?". Use pvAnnotateTimeFilter to label the time of a particular dataset, and pvText for fixed text.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Format uses fmt syntax with the argument {time}; legacy printf %f is converted with a warning.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AnnotateTime`. Identity: `sources/TimeToTextConvertorSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Format` | The value of this property is a format string used to display the input time. The format string is specified using fmt style. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAnnotateTime"
}
```
